leadText: The Battle for More Friends! (Japanese: 仲間を増やしてバトル！！ Companion-Increasing Battle!!) is the third chapter of the Be the Best! Pokémon B+W manga. It was published in the October 2010 issue of CoroCoro Comics Special.
